title: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) (Amendment) Act
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE LAND (RESTRICTIONS ON ALIENATION) ACT, NO. 38 OF 2014
gazette_note: Published as a Supplement to Part II of the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka of February 23, 2017

edition.caveat: read from the Government Printer PDF

source_location.note: Page 1 is the Government Printer cover, page 3 the subscription imprint. The whole enacting text -- sections 1 to 3 -- is on page 2.

provenance.against: Government Printer PDF, page 2, read directly
provenance.what_changed: Removed subscription-imprint text that the parser had run into the tail of section 3; dropped an empty operations list on the section 2 instruction; put certified_on into ISO form and kept the printed wording alongside it; recorded which PDF pages the text came from.
provenance.note: Re-running scripts/parse_amendment_pdf.py writes data/processed/canonical-amendments/3-2017.json, not this file. scripts/finalize_statute.py leaves a tree carrying provenance.hand_corrected in place.

verification_note: Structure, headings, instruction targets and metadata checked line by line against page 2 of the Government Printer PDF. The wording is the printed wording. Legal effect is still unverified and needs a lawyer.

body.heading: Short title and date of operation.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Land (Restrictions on Alienation) (Amendment) Act, No. 3 of 2017 and shall be deemed to have come into operation with effect from January 8, 2017.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Land (Restrictions on Alienation) (Amendment) Act, No. 3 of 2017 and shall be deemed to have come into operation with effect from January 8, 2017.

body.heading: Insertion of new section 5A in Act, No. 38 of 2014.
body.raw_text: 2. The following new section is hereby inserted immediately after section 5 of the Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, No. 38 of 2014 and shall have effect as section 5A of that Act:--

provision.heading: Land Lease Tax not to be levied with effect from January 8, 2017.
provision.raw_text: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in any of the provisions of this Act, the provisions relating to the Land Lease Tax shall not apply to a lease of any land-- (a) to a foreigner; or (b) to a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, where any foreign shareholding in such company, either direct or indirect, is fifty per cent or above; or (c) to a foreign company, under and indenture of lease executed on or after January 8, 2017, and accordingly the Land Lease Tax shall not be charged, levied or collected from any such person or company on or after such date.".

body.raw_text: 3. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
